exact: inhibition of appetite by leptin signaling
negative regulation of appetite by leptin-mediated signalling pathway
reduction of appetite by leptin-mediated signaling

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by leptin binding to its receptor on the surface of a cell, which reduces appetite, the desire or physical craving for food.
label: negative regulation of appetite by leptin-mediated signaling pathway
